name: salesforce
description: Salesforce CRM integration via the Salesforce REST API (v62.0) — run SOQL queries and SOSL full-text searches, fetch and describe objects, create and update records, and log Task activities. Uses OAuth2 client credentials against your org's My Domain with an External Client App and a run-as integration user; an access token is minted per invocation (no refresh token).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Salesforce CRM records, SOQL/SOSL, and activities (client-credentials)

fields.label: My Domain URL
fields.helpText: Your org's My Domain URL, e.g. https://acme.my.salesforce.com. Required — the client credentials flow does not work against login.salesforce.com.

fields.label: Consumer Key (Client ID)
fields.helpText: The Consumer Key of your External Client App with OAuth and the Client Credentials Flow enabled.

fields.label: Consumer Secret (Client Secret)
fields.helpText: The Consumer Secret of the External Client App.

tools.name: sf.soql_query
tools.description: Run a SOQL query and return the matching records, following pagination up to a capped number of pages.

soql.description: The SOQL query to run, e.g. SELECT Id, Name, StageName FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false

tools.name: sf.search
tools.description: Run a SOSL full-text search across objects and return the matching records.

sosl.description: The SOSL search string, e.g. FIND {Acme} IN NAME FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name), Contact(Id, Name, Email)

tools.name: sf.get_record
tools.description: Fetch a single record by object type and record Id, optionally limited to specific fields.

objectType.description: API name of the object, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, Lead, Case

fields.description: Field API names to return (omit for all accessible fields)

tools.name: sf.describe_object
tools.description: Describe an object's fields — names, labels, types, and active picklist values.

objectType.description: API name of the object to describe, e.g. Opportunity or MyCustomObject__c

tools.name: sf.create_record
tools.description: Create a new record of the given object type from a fields object.

objectType.description: API name of the object to create, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity

fields.description: Field API name to value map for the new record, e.g. {"Name": "Acme Corp", "Industry": "Technology"}

tools.name: sf.update_record
tools.description: Update fields on an existing record by object type and record Id.

objectType.description: API name of the object, e.g. Account, Opportunity

recordId.description: The Id of the record to update

fields.description: Field API name to new value map, e.g. {"StageName": "Closed Won"}

tools.name: sf.add_task
tools.description: Create a Task activity, optionally linked to a person (WhoId: Contact/Lead) and/or a related record (WhatId: Account, Opportunity, ...).

subject.description: Task subject, e.g. Follow up on renewal

whoId.description: Id of the Contact or Lead the task is about

whatId.description: Id of the related record (Account, Opportunity, Case, ...)
